policy: Only claims with an identified, reviewable source and appropriate usage rights may be published. Historical presence is not evidence of a current client relationship, endorsement or measurable outcome.

rules.clientResult: Requires item-level evidence for the client identity if named, the project relationship, the result or metric, and any quotation used.
rules.testimonial: Requires a attributable source and explicit publication approval; never infer wording from project history or logos.
rules.currentRelationship: Requires current relationship evidence. Historical logos or archived pages are insufficient.
rules.media: Requires source provenance plus publication-rights approval. Pending or unresolved provenance media must not be used as portfolio evidence.
rules.historicalReference: May establish historical presence on a source page only; it must be time-qualified and must not imply endorsement, current engagement or performance.
rules.regulatedResponsibility: Requires separate provider, contracting-party and professional-responsibility verification before publication as an own-delivery claim.

evidenceSets.allowedUse: HIPStudio founding date, 2006 heritage and founder attribution only as described by the cited source records.
Named professional-partner descriptions already present in people.json. Specific project roles remain agreement-dependent.

Historical/reference display only with non-endorsement language. Must not be used to assert a current customer, partner, client outcome or ongoing engagement.
